reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Using raw values instead of coded values in the formula.
Mixing T-RTS (sum of codes) with weighted RTS.
name: Revised Trauma Score

version.label: RTS (Champion et al. 1989), weighted
version.detail: Coded GCS, systolic BP and respiratory rate (0–4 each). RTS = 0.9368 GCSc + 0.7326 SBPc + 0.2908 RRc, range 0–7.8408. The triage version (T-RTS, 0–12) is shown alongside.

intendedPopulation: Injured patients, using first recorded values.

calculatorNotice.title: Lower is worse
calculatorNotice.message: RTS is weighted toward GCS. Respiratory rate and the verbal component are unreliable after intubation.

resultStates.label: All coded values normal
resultStates.summary: All three coded values normal at this assessment (maximum RTS).
resultStates.detail: Physiology can deteriorate; RTS does not describe anatomical injury.

resultStates.label: RTS {fixed(total, 4)}
resultStates.summary: Lower values indicate greater physiological derangement.

resultStates.label: RTS below 4
resultStates.summary: A threshold below 4 has been proposed to identify severe injury.
resultStates.detail: Correlate with full assessment and the local trauma protocol.

clinicalContext.text: A physiological score used in triage and in trauma outcome models (e.g. TRISS).

limitations.text: Unreliable in intubated patients (respiratory rate and verbal response).

limitations: Physiology changes rapidly; values are timepoint-specific.
Does not describe anatomical injury (see ISS).

confounders.effect: Change BP and RR before measurement.

guideSections.what: A weighted sum of coded GCS, systolic BP and respiratory rate.
guideSections.whenToUse: Initial physiological assessment after injury; trauma registries.
guideSections.howToPerform: Enter the first recorded values; each is converted to a 0–4 code and weighted.
guideSections.clinicalContext: Combined with anatomical scores in outcome models.

sources.citation: Champion HR, Sacco WJ, Copes WS, Gann DS, Gennarelli TA, Flanagan ME. A revision of the Trauma Score. J Trauma. 1989;29(5):623-629.
